أبتلي (form VIII)
# أَبْتَلِي (ʔabtalī) /ʔab.ta.liː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# أَبْتَلِيَ (ʔabtaliya) /ʔab.ta.li.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
